text:
Dana Rivera: Heads-up 1wk out from launch. Need a compact benchmark narrative that leads with latency vs cost for the landing hero, plus two appendix visuals and simple inbound routing for demo vs report downloads. Objective: one glance clarity for engineers + procurement. Who can take hooks, visuals, routing?

Owen Blake: I can do hooks. Leaning toward contrastive lines: 1) 'Latency you trust, costs you control' 2) 'Production-grade latency, procurement-friendly economics' 3) 'Optimize for humans and the ledger'  short, testable.

Priya Menon: Visual plan: Hero = bivariate scatter (p95 latency on x, $/1M tokens on y) with a shaded "sweet spot" and 3 exemplar model variants annotated. Appendix A = waterfall showing baseline vs batching vs quantization savings. Appendix B = small multiple timeline showing p95 under load. I'll export colorblind-safe PNG + annotated SVG.

Marco Ruiz: Routing: capture hidden field lead_intent (demo|benchmark). If demo or company_employee_count>75 -> route to SDRs and flag for enterprise follow-up. Else -> auto-email with PDF + webinar RSVP slot. Mark lead_score: +3 demo, +1 webinar RSVP, +2 PDF download within 48h. Quick pseudo: 

```python
intent = form.get('lead_intent')
size = int(form.get('company_employee_count',0))
if intent=='demo' or size>75:
    assign='sdr'
else:
    assign='growth'
```

engops-bot: Reminder: Marketing check-in scheduled 2024-07-03 09:00 UTC. Calendar invite created.

Dana Rivera: Two social hooks needed (technical and outcome) + one-paragraph webinar blurb for the registration page. Deadline: final assets by Tue 16:00 so Growth can sequence emails.

Owen Blake: Socials: tech -> 'Map latency vs unit cost. Find the operational sweet spot.' outcome -> 'Same throughput, lower bill  see the real numbers.' Will paste drafts here tomorrow.

Priya Menon: I'll upload the hero mock and two appendix visuals to the marketing drive by EOD Monday. Suggest hero alt text: 'Scatter plot of p95 latency vs cost per million tokens with highlighted sweet spot.'

Marco Ruiz: I'll push routing rules to infra repo and share the link. Also will include a sample SQL to pull demo-intent leads for SDRs.

Dana Rivera: Decisions: hero = scatter, appendix = waterfall + timeline; CTAs = Request demo (primary), Download benchmark & Register for webinar (secondary). Routing as Marco outlined. I'll consolidate into the launch playbook and assign tasks. Thanks all.
